en.title: Karnataka High Court strikes down attempt to increase reservation for SCs/STs, declares it unconstitutional
en.summary: The Karnataka High Court rejected an effort to raise reservation levels for scheduled castes and tribes, ruling that the constitutional ceiling of 50% total reservation cannot be exceeded.
